REMOVAL OF OIL PUMP

1. REMOVE HOOD

2. REMOVE ENGINE UNDER COVER

3. DRAIN ENGINE OIL

4. (A/T)
REMOVE A/T OIL COOLER HOSE CLAMP

5. REMOVE NO. 1 FRONT SUSPENSION CROSSMEMBER

6. REMOVE EXHAUST FRONT PIPE BRACKET AND
STIFFENER PLATES

7. (7M-GTE)
DISCONNECT ENGINE OIL COOLER HOSE FROM OIL PAN
